title: Coordinate decision tree
statement: A coordinate decision tree with coordinates in $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and values in a type $\alpha$ is either a leaf labeled by an element of $\alpha$, or a query at one coordinate with a zero-child and a one-child, each of which is a coordinate decision tree of the same kind.
